output.summary: A tropical flowering plant native to tropical America, although its exact native range is uncertain, tannia is an important starchy crop. Its secondary corms and leaves are eaten; corms should be boiled to reduce irritation, while primary corms are generally reserved for animal feed because they contain more oxalates.
